mapper.select: SELECT f.fair_id , f.name AS fair_name , f.status AS fair_status , f.reservation_start_date , f.reservation_end_date , f.reservation_fee , f.published_at , f.canceled_at , fd.fair_date_id , fd.operation_date , fd.capacity FROM fairs f JOIN fair_dates fd ON fd.fair_id = f.fair_id WHERE f.fair_id = #{fairId} AND fd.operation_date = #{visitDate} FOR UPDATE OF fd
SELECT user_id , nickname , phone , email , role , status FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation_histories ( reservation_id , action_type , before_data , after_data , changed_by , is_admin_action , change_reason , created_at ) VALUES ( #{reservationId} , 'CREATED' , NULL , JSON_OBJECT('status', #{status}) , #{changedBy} , FALSE , NULL , NOW() )
